name: LIFE-01: Full pipeline: seal, attach a filter, detach, delete
setup: sh -c 'for attempt in $(seq 1 200); do output=$($TC p4template del pipeline/ptables 2>&1); rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && break; case "$output" in *"Pipeline in use"*) sleep 0.05;; *) break;; esac; done; [ -z "$output" ] || printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$output" >&2; exit "$rc"'
$TC p4template create action/ptables/test actid 1 param param1 type bit32
$TC actions add action ptables/test param param1 1 index 100
$TC p4template create extern/root/DirectCounter extid 0x1A000000 numinstances 2 has_exec_method

$TC p4template create extern_inst/ptables/DirectCounter/cnt instid 1 tc_numel 16 tbl_bindable constructor param type ptype bit32 0 control_path tc_key index ptype bit32 id 1 param pkts ptype bit64 id 2
$TC p4template create extern_inst/ptables/myext/inst1 instid 1 control_path tc_key index ptype bit32 param value ptype bit32
$TC p4template create table/ptables/cb/t1 keysz 16 pna_direct_counter DirectCounter/cnt table_acts act name ptables/test act name ptables/a2 default_hit_action action ptables/test param param1 1
$TC p4template update table/ptables/cb/t1 default_miss_action action ptables/a2
$TC p4template create table/ptables/cb/t2 keysz 16 table_acts act name ptables/a2 default_miss_action action ptables/a2
ip link add dev p4d$TESTID type dummy
$TC filter add dev p4d$TESTID ingress protocol all prio 1 p4 pname ptables action ok
cmdUnderTest: $TC filter del dev p4d$TESTID ingress && (for attempt in $(seq 1 200); do output=$($TC p4template del pipeline/ptables 2>&1); rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && break; case "$output" in *"Pipeline in use"*) sleep 0.05;; *) break;; esac; done; [ -z "$output" ] || printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; exit "$rc") && $TC p4template del extern/root/myext && $TC p4template del extern/root/DirectCounter
teardown: sh -c 'for attempt in $(seq 1 200); do output=$($TC p4template del pipeline/ptables 2>&1); rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && break; case "$output" in *"Pipeline in use"*) sleep 0.05;; *) break;; esac; done; [ -z "$output" ] || printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$output" >&2; exit "$rc"'

setup: sh -c 'for attempt in $(seq 1 200); do output=$($TC p4template del pipeline/ptables 2>&1); rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && break; case "$output" in *"Pipeline in use"*) sleep 0.05;; *) break;; esac; done; [ -z "$output" ] || printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$output" >&2; exit "$rc"'
ip netns exec p4ns$TESTID $TC p4template create pipeline/ptables pipeid 22 numtables 2
ip netns exec p4ns$TESTID $TC p4template create action/ptables/test actid 1 param param1 type bit32
ip netns exec p4ns$TESTID $TC p4template create action/ptables/a2 actid 2
ip netns exec p4ns$TESTID $TC p4template create action/ptables/a3 actid 3
ip netns exec p4ns$TESTID $TC p4template update action/ptables/test state active
ip netns exec p4ns$TESTID $TC p4template update action/ptables/a2 state active
ip netns exec p4ns$TESTID $TC actions add action ptables/test param param1 1 index 100
ip netns exec p4ns$TESTID $TC p4template create extern/root/DirectCounter extid 0x1A000000 numinstances 2 has_exec_method

ip netns exec p4ns$TESTID $TC p4template create extern_inst/ptables/DirectCounter/cnt instid 1 tc_numel 16 tbl_bindable constructor param type ptype bit32 0 control_path tc_key index ptype bit32 id 1 param pkts ptype bit64 id 2
ip netns exec p4ns$TESTID $TC p4template create extern/root/myext extid 1 numinstances 1
ip netns exec p4ns$TESTID $TC p4template create extern_inst/ptables/myext/inst1 instid 1 control_path tc_key index ptype bit32 param value ptype bit32

ip netns exec p4ns$TESTID $TC p4template create table/ptables/cb/t1 keysz 16 pna_direct_counter DirectCounter/cnt table_acts act name ptables/test act name ptables/a2 default_hit_action action ptables/test param param1 1
ip netns exec p4ns$TESTID $TC p4template update table/ptables/cb/t1 default_miss_action action ptables/a2
ip netns exec p4ns$TESTID $TC p4template create table/ptables/cb/t2 keysz 16 table_acts act name ptables/a2 default_miss_action action ptables/a2
ip netns exec p4ns$TESTID $TC p4template update pipeline/ptables state ready
ip netns exec p4ns$TESTID ip link add dev p4d$TESTID type dummy
ip netns exec p4ns$TESTID $TC qdisc add dev p4d$TESTID clsact
ip netns exec p4ns$TESTID $TC filter add dev p4d$TESTID ingress protocol all prio 1 p4 pname ptables action ok
cmdUnderTest: ip netns del p4ns$TESTID; sleep 2; $TC p4template del extern/root/myext && $TC p4template del extern/root/DirectCounter
teardown: sh -c 'for attempt in $(seq 1 200); do output=$($TC p4template del pipeline/ptables 2>&1); rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && break; case "$output" in *"Pipeline in use"*) sleep 0.05;; *) break;; esac; done; [ -z "$output" ] || printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$output" >&2; exit "$rc"'

name: LIFE-03: Create and delete a full pipeline 100 times
setup: sh -c 'for attempt in $(seq 1 200); do output=$($TC p4template del pipeline/ptables 2>&1); rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && break; case "$output" in *"Pipeline in use"*) sleep 0.05;; *) break;; esac; done; [ -z "$output" ] || printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$output" >&2; exit "$rc"'
cmdUnderTest: for i in $(seq 1 100); do $TC p4template create pipeline/ptables pipeid 22 numtables 2 && $TC p4template create action/ptables/test actid 1 param param1 type bit32 && $TC p4template create action/ptables/a2 actid 2 && $TC p4template create action/ptables/a3 actid 3 && $TC p4template update action/ptables/test state active && $TC p4template update action/ptables/a2 state active && $TC actions add action ptables/test param param1 1 index 100 && $TC p4template create extern/root/DirectCounter extid 0x1A000000 numinstances 2 has_exec_method && $TC p4template create extern_inst/ptables/DirectCounter/cnt instid 1 tc_numel 16 tbl_bindable constructor param type ptype bit32 0 control_path tc_key index ptype bit32 id 1 param pkts ptype bit64 id 2 && $TC p4template create extern/root/myext extid 1 numinstances 1 && $TC p4template create extern_inst/ptables/myext/inst1 instid 1 control_path tc_key index ptype bit32 param value ptype bit32 && $TC p4template create table/ptables/cb/t1 keysz 16 pna_direct_counter DirectCounter/cnt table_acts act name ptables/test act name ptables/a2 default_hit_action action ptables/test param param1 1 && $TC p4template update table/ptables/cb/t1 default_miss_action action ptables/a2 && $TC p4template create table/ptables/cb/t2 keysz 16 table_acts act name ptables/a2 default_miss_action action ptables/a2 && $TC p4template update pipeline/ptables state ready && $TC p4template del pipeline/ptables && $TC p4template del extern/root/myext && $TC p4template del extern/root/DirectCounter || exit 1; done
teardown: sh -c 'for attempt in $(seq 1 200); do output=$($TC p4template del pipeline/ptables 2>&1); rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && break; case "$output" in *"Pipeline in use"*) sleep 0.05;; *) break;; esac; done; [ -z "$output" ] || printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$output" >&2; exit "$rc"'
